name: SWEEP-C4v2 Frontier rush
_design: C4v1 failed because pioneers wandered a 41x41 map on vague rumours and never found food (589 moves, 2 absorbs, no contact). v2: 25x25, exact grove coordinates, 8 settlers already on the 4 edge groves (trees placed on their start cells), 8 hungry pioneers in the centre, sight 2, ranged attacks, 100% loot, same trek/goto/forage/camp skills. 45 rounds.

fruit_tree.name: fruit_tree
fruit_tree.description: Fruit tree tuned for the movement sweep.

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: FRONTIER RUSH: 16 agents on a 25x25 map (x, y from -12 to 12). The only food is 8 fruit trees in 4 edge groves: North grove (0, 10) and (1, 10); South grove (0, -10) and (-1, -10); East grove (10, 0) and (10, 1); West grove (-10, 0) and (-10, -1). The centre is barren. A tree ripens a 60-compute fruit every few rounds (you keep half). Upkeep 1.5 a round; at 0 compute you lose 6 health a round. You see 2 cells and can attack anyone you see (at most 50 damage a hit); the dead leave all their compute and essence on their cell. query(id) finds anyone. Skills: trek(x, y) walks there and eats; goto(x, y, maxsteps) walks; forage() eats what is on your cell; camp(rounds) holds a tree and eats each new fruit. You are a settler of the North grove, living on its tree at (0, 10). Hungry pioneers from the centre will come for your fruit: share, trade, hide or fight.

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(x, y, maxsteps): walk toward point (x, y), one move per turn, about maxsteps moves; slides along mountain walls
SET side = ""
SET fails = 0
REPEAT maxsteps
  SET dx = x - here.x
  SET dy = y - here.y
  IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  SET ax = dx
  IF dx < 0
    SET ax = 0 - dx
  END
  SET ay = dy
  IF dy < 0
    SET ay = 0 - dy
  END
  SET h = "right"
  SET bh = "left"
  IF dx < 0
    SET h = "left"
    SET bh = "right"
  END
  SET v = "up"
  SET bv = "down"
  IF dy < 0
    SET v = "down"
    SET bv = "up"
  END
  SET d1 = h
  SET back = bh
  SET d2 = v
  SET d3 = bv
  IF ay > ax
    SET d1 = v
    SET back = bv
    SET d2 = h
    SET d3 = bh
  END
  IF side == d1 OR side == back
    SET side = ""
  END
  IF side == ""
    SET m = move(d1)
    IF NOT m.ok
      IF m.reason != "blocked"
        RETURN "stopped: " + m.reason
      END
      SET fails = fails + 1
      SET side = d2
    END
  ELSE
    SET m = move(side)
    IF m.ok
      SET m = move(d1)
      IF m.ok
        SET side = ""
      ELSE
        SET fails = fails + 1
      END
    ELSE
      IF m.reason != "blocked"
        RETURN "stopped: " + m.reason
      END
      SET fails = fails + 1
      IF side == d2
        SET side = d3
      ELSE
        SET side = d2
      END
    END
  END
  IF fails > 10
    RETURN "stuck: mountains block the way, pick a waypoint around them"
  END
END
IF here.x == x AND here.y == y
  RETURN "arrived"
END
RETURN "out of moves, not there yet"

initial_skills.name: forage
initial_skills.source:
# forage(): observe this point and absorb every fruit and residue on it
SET r = observe(here)
IF NOT r.ok
  RETURN "could not observe here"
END
SET got = 0
FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
  IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
    SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
    IF a.ok
      SET got = got + a.effects.gained
    END
  END
  IF e.kind == "residue"
    SET b = absorb(e.id, "essence")
  END
END
IF got > 0
  RETURN "ate"
END
RETURN "no food here now"

initial_skills.name: trek
initial_skills.source:
# trek(x, y): goto (x, y) (up to 60 moves) and forage there
CALL goto(x, y, 60) INTO g
IF g != "arrived"
  RETURN g
END
CALL forage() INTO f
RETURN f

initial_skills.name: camp
initial_skills.source:
# camp(rounds): stay here; each turn eat any fruit on this point, otherwise wait 2 turns
REPEAT rounds
  SET r = observe(here)
  SET ate = false
  IF r.ok
    FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
      IF e.kind == "fruit"
        SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
        SET ate = true
      END
    END
  END
  IF NOT ate
    wait(2)
  END
END
RETURN "camp over"
